# Tendercraft

> Tendercraft builds focused, private, offline software for Windows PCs and Amazon Fire tablets. No ads, no mandatory cloud accounts, no analytics.

## Windows Desktop Apps (Microsoft Store)

- [Tendercraft Windows Apps Hub](https://tendercrafthq.com/apps/windows): Native, privacy-first desktop utilities, distributed through the Microsoft Store.
- [Vox Reader Product Page](https://tendercrafthq.com/apps/vox-reader) / [Microsoft Store](https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9PCVQB5H684W): Offline English text-to-speech reader for Windows 10 (version 19041+) and Windows 11, x64. Reads DRM-free EPUB, TXT and pasted text aloud with sentence highlighting, bookmarks, saved positions and a sleep timer, using voices that run on the PC. Free: three voices and three listening hours per week. Optional one-time Vox Reader Pro ($18.99 USD in the US Store; regional prices vary) adds unlimited listening, all 11 voices, text-based PDF and Word (DOCX) import and custom pronunciations. Reading aloud works offline after installation; buying or refreshing Pro needs Store connectivity. Not an audiobook-file player. Alternative to Speechify, NaturalReader and Balabolka for people who want offline listening without a subscription. PAD XML: https://tendercrafthq.com/vox-reader/pad.xml
- [Cropmark Product Page](https://tendercrafthq.com/apps/cropmark) / [Microsoft Store](https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9NZR4D24CMM6): Screenshot capture, annotation and redaction tool for Windows 11 (build 22000+), x64. Region and full-screen capture, arrows, boxes, text, numbered step badges and solid redaction that replaces the covered pixels in the exported image. Free exports PNG, JPEG or a single-image PDF with no watermark. Optional Cropmark Pro (one-time or yearly in the Microsoft Store) adds multi-image projects, batch export, saved styles and multi-image PDF export. Review exports before sharing: original captures and editable projects keep the original content. Alternative to Snagit, Greenshot and ShareX. PAD XML: https://tendercrafthq.com/cropmark/pad.xml
- [Still-Lane Product Page](https://tendercrafthq.com/apps/still-lane) / [Microsoft Store](https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9NP26W128KX9): Private app-usage and screen time tracker for Windows 10 (version 19041+) and Windows 11, x64. After consent it records which app is in front and for how long, with active and idle time shown separately, and stores the records on the PC. It does not record window titles, websites, keystrokes or screenshots; browser time counts as one app. Daily app/category budgets and focus sessions give reminders that can be snoozed or overridden; Still-Lane never blocks or closes apps. CSV/JSON export and data deletion. Paid app ($14.99 USD one-time in the US Store) with a 15-day free trial offered through the Microsoft Store. Alternative to StayFree, RescueTime and ActivityWatch for people who want local-only app-time reports. PAD XML: https://tendercrafthq.com/still-lane/pad.xml

## Windows app guides

- [How to permanently redact screenshots on Windows](https://tendercrafthq.com/apps/cropmark/how-to-permanently-redact-screenshots): Solid pixel replacement versus overlays that can expose content, and checking the exported file.
- [How to listen to EPUB and PDF books offline on Windows](https://tendercrafthq.com/apps/vox-reader/listen-to-books-offline-windows): Turning EPUB, text-based PDF (Vox Reader Pro) and articles into speech without an internet connection.
- [How to track Windows screen time privately](https://tendercrafthq.com/apps/still-lane/private-screen-time-tracking-guide): Local app-time tracking with reminders you can override, without cloud uploads.

## Fire Tablet Apps

- [Visual Schedule Board](https://tendercrafthq.com/apps/visual-schedule-board): An offline picture-routine app for Amazon Fire tablets. Parents and teachers build step-by-step visual schedules from 74 built-in pictures or their own photos, and children follow them one step at a time. Includes a First / Then view, optional quiet timers and a parent gate. Free to start with a one-time unlock, no subscription. Guides: [First / Then board guide](https://tendercrafthq.com/apps/visual-schedule-board/first-then-board-guide), [free printable routine charts](https://tendercrafthq.com/apps/visual-schedule-board/printable-morning-routine-chart), [classroom setup](https://tendercrafthq.com/apps/visual-schedule-board/visual-schedule-for-classroom), [bedtime routine pictures](https://tendercrafthq.com/apps/visual-schedule-board/bedtime-routine-pictures), [Fire tablet setup](https://tendercrafthq.com/apps/visual-schedule-board/visual-schedule-app-fire-tablet).
- [Recipe Box for Fire tablets](https://tendercrafthq.com/apps/recipe-box): An offline recipe organizer for Amazon Fire tablets. Import recipes from most cooking websites with a pasted link; Cook Mode shows one big step at a time, keeps the screen on, and turns times in steps into one-tap timers that keep running when you switch apps; scale ingredients 1/2x, 2x, 3x; one-tap grocery list; backup and restore to a file. Free for 20 recipes, then a one-time unlock, no subscription. Available on the [Amazon Appstore](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0HMPLF4MM).
- [Large Print Crosswords](https://tendercrafthq.com/apps/large-print-crosswords): English-language crossword app by Tendercraft for compatible Fire tablets, published on Amazon Appstore October 15, 2026. Includes 150 compact crosswords: 120 library puzzles plus 30 in a repeating daily rotation. Three text sizes, two themes, offline play, no timer, no ads or account. Paid app without subscriptions or in-app purchases. Not a printed puzzle book or a Kindle e-reader app. Product facts and support: https://tendercrafthq.com/apps/large-print-crosswords

## Recipe Box guides

- [Best recipe app for a Fire tablet](https://tendercrafthq.com/apps/recipe-box/best-recipe-app-for-fire-tablet): Checklist and options for choosing a recipe app on a Fire tablet.
- [Offline recipe app](https://tendercrafthq.com/apps/recipe-box/offline-recipe-app): What works without Wi-Fi in Recipe Box and how to back up recipes.
- [Grocery list from recipes](https://tendercrafthq.com/apps/recipe-box/grocery-list-from-recipes): Turn saved recipes into a shopping list on a Fire tablet.
- [Recipe Box vs Paprika, Pinterest and a notes app](https://tendercrafthq.com/apps/recipe-box/recipe-box-vs-paprika-pinterest-notes): Comparison of ways to keep recipes on a tablet.
